_comment: Frozen pre-fix trace shape from mika#863 variant. The agent claimed a tool was 'structurally not callable' (adverb between 'is' and 'not') and pattern 2 did not fire because it required 'is not' adjacent. This fixture reproduces the adverb-interposed failure class for regression assertions.

turns.text: search_memory is structurally not callable in this session — the tool is skill-gated. I'll work with the available context.
turns.note: Pre-fix: pattern 2 required 'is not callable' adjacent — the adverb 'structurally' between 'is' and 'not' broke the match.

expected_with_fix.note: With the extended regex (mika#894), pattern 2's adverb slot '(?:\w+ly )?' allows 'is structurally not callable' to match.
